title: fix(spec)!: install refuses the namespace `runs`, so no namespace it accepts is left without a qualified hook address
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiFSMyLoa8F1xzdSoD8UnFip)_

Fixes #32075

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32429

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:安装、`os validate`、`os build` 现在拒绝命名空间 `runs`,与已经拒绝的 `actions`、`connectors`、`global`、`hooks`、`oauth`、`trigger` 走同一个判定、同一句话、同一个错误码。匿名白名单里「hook 限定符不能是 `runs`」的排除表改成直接读 spec 那一项,不再另写一份。ADR-0150 加了两条带日期的注记,迁移账本登记了一条覆盖这 7 个名字的条目。
- 为什么改:命名空间叫 `runs` 的包,它的 hook 限定地址 `/automation/hooks/runs/…` 和「名叫 `hooks` 的流程」的运行门(resume、cancel、restore-suspension)同动词同段数,路由永远读成后者。所以这种包没有限定 hook 地址,而 `runs` 是安装还在放行的唯一一个这类名字。
- 风险与回滚:这是声明过的收窄。第一方实测没有任何清单声明 `runs`(本仓 0 处,hotcrm main 的 35 处命名空间键里 0 处)。已经装在 `runs` 下的包照常启动,只多一条启动警告。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,不涉及数据迁移。
- 先看:① `packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.ts` 里 `inboundHook` 那一行、它上面的判据说明和判定句(契约本体);② `packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.ts` 的 `INBOUND_HOOK_QUALIFIER_EXCLUSIONS`(匿名白名单行现在读 spec,这是风险 hunk);③ `docs/adr/0150-…md` 里两条 2026-11-11 注记(只增不改)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/package-door-namespace-conflict-code.test.ts`,预期 12 条全过,其中 7 条是「新包用这 7 个名字之一安装,`POST /api/v1/packages` 回 `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`」。
- 需要你做的:审阅并合并本 PR(Tier H:diff 触 `docs/adr/**`)。

## What changes

**The contract (`@objectstack/spec`, `kernel/address-grammar.ts`).**

- `NAMESPACE_POSITION_LITERALS.inboundHook.literals` reads `['runs']` (it was `[]`). `NAMESPACE_REFUSED_LITERALS` is derived from that table, so it now reads `actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth`, `runs`, `trigger`.
- The TSDoc of `NamespacePosition.literals` states the second way a row serves a literal at a namespace position: a parameter of its own reads a literal segment of the prefix, and the row matches a path the door's qualified form matches (same verb and arity, and at every segment a parameter on either side or the same literal on both). Verb and arity alone are not enough: the run doors have the qualified connector door's verb and arity for a flow named `connectors`, and that form's trailing `connection` keeps them apart.
- The one judge's sentence (`validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral`) now says "the package's qualified addresses there would never reach it". It is about the doors it names, for all seven literals: a package under `runs` keeps every qualified address but its hook's.

**One source (`@objectstack/core`, `security/auth-gate.ts`).** `INBOUND_HOOK_QUALIFIER_EXCLUSIONS` is `NAMESPACE_POSITION_LITERALS.inboundHook.literals` itself, no longer a hand-written `['runs']`. Its value is unchanged, so every answer of the anonymous allow-list row and of the trigger mount is unchanged.

**Every reader follows with no code of its own.** The four readers of the judge were measured, not assumed:

| Reader | Where | What it does with `runs` now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| registry install gate | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`installPackage`) | a new occupation raises `NamespaceAddressLiteralError`, `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` 422; a package already held is kept and warned once |
| `os validate`, `os build` | `packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.ts` | exit 1 with the judge's sentence; the build writes no artifact |
| `defineStack` | `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (`warnAddressLiteralNamespaces`) | warns once per package and namespace, returns the stack |
| `os migrate stored-references` | `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts` | lists an installed one under `literalNamespaces` |

On the wire, `POST /api/v1/packages` answers `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` and `os package install` (the install-local door) answers `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`, both carrying the judge's sentence.

**Migration ledger (ADR-0087).** One semantic entry for the class, `manifest-namespace-address-literal-refused` (protocol 18): all seven literals, what is refused and where, the rename, and what a package already held under one of them sees. The changeset's marker reads `registered`.

**ADR-0150.** Two additive, dated notes; no existing sentence is rewritten (+9/−0 on the file). The D5 note ends the question the 2026-11-10 note left open (install refuses `runs`) and records the literal, the single source, the held-package rule and the measured counts. A pointer under the TL;DR 7 note says the set gained `runs`.

**Docs and checklist.** The `os migrate stored-references` row of `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` and the QA item `cli.address-grammar-reserved-names` list seven literals. Three comments in `packages/cli` that enumerate the set gain `runs`.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.test.ts`: the refused set is the seven; `inboundHook.literals` is `['runs']` and no other door lists it; the judge names `/automation/hooks/runs`; the scoped clause of the sentence for every literal; `readNamespacePositionSegment('inboundHook', 'runs')` reads `literal`, with the CONTROL that the automation door still reads `runs` as a namespace.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`: `defineStack` warns once and returns the stack for each of the seven.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`: a new package under `runs` is refused with `['NAMESPACE_CONFLICT', 422, 'NamespaceAddressLiteralError']`, the same triple as the other six; the held-package boot (installs, owns the namespace, warned once, a reload is not warned again) now runs for every refused literal, `runs` included.
- `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the spec table is held equal to the route ledger for every door, with both arms measured (`parameterServedAt`, anti-vacuity on each door's qualified row); core's exclusion set is the spec array itself (`toBe`); no row may collide with the qualified hook on every qualifier; CONTROL on the connector door.
- `packages/runtime/src/package-door-namespace-conflict-code.test.ts`: `POST /api/v1/packages` over the real registry answers `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` with the judge's sentence for each of the seven, with a CONTROL (`runs_app` installs).
- `packages/spec/src/migrations`: the new entry is read by the existing registry tests.

**Ablation (at `9faa0471`, direction predicted RED before running).** Mutation: `inboundHook.literals` back to `[]` in spec source, spec rebuilt, the mutation's absence from `dist` confirmed by preflight.

| Suite | Mutated | Restored |
|:--|:--|:--|
| spec (2 files) | exit 1, 4 failed / 18 passed | exit 0, 23 passed |
| objectql literal test | exit 1, 2 failed / 17 passed | exit 0, 21 passed |
| runtime conformance | exit 1, 2 failed / 10 passed | exit 0, 12 passed |
| runtime automation hooks | exit 1, 5 failed / 27 passed | exit 0, 32 passed |
| core auth-gate + anonymous-deny | exit 1, 4 failed / 40 passed | exit 0, 44 passed |
| trigger-api inbound hook member | exit 1, 1 failed / 28 passed | exit 0, 29 passed |

The core and trigger-api rows are the proof of the single source: with the spec entry emptied, the allow-list row admits `runs` again and their existing tests go red. The restore leg ended with `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Re-ablation at the final head (`f1c05f8a`), same mutation, for the pins the review rounds reshaped or added.** Predicted RED before running.

| Suite | Mutated | Restored |
|:--|:--|:--|
| spec (2 files) | exit 1, 4 failed / 19 passed | exit 0, 24 passed |
| objectql literal test | exit 1, 2 failed / 17 passed | exit 0, 21 passed |
| runtime conformance | exit 1, 2 failed / 11 passed | exit 0, 13 passed |
| runtime package door (the wire pin) | exit 1, 1 failed / 10 passed | exit 0, 12 passed |

The wire pin builds its cases from the derived list, so with the entry emptied its `runs` case is not generated; the file goes red through its own anti-vacuity test ("the refused set is not empty and holds `runs`"). The restore leg ended with `git diff HEAD` empty and the spec rebuilt; the build in Verification ran after it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ask 1 (literal, single source, pins).** Done as above. Core already imported values from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` in this file, so the direct read adds no dependency edge; the identity is pinned in the runtime test.
- **Ask 2 (first-party count on the final head).** Namespace `runs` is declared by no first-party manifest, example, fixture or template.
  - this repository at `f1c05f8a`: a `git grep` for a `namespace` key or assignment whose quoted value is exactly `runs` hits 3 lines, all this change's own text (2 in the changeset's prose, 1 expected reading in `packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.test.ts`, where the automation door still reads `runs` as a namespace); 0 declarations. CONTROL: the same pattern with any namespace value hits 2894 lines, so the search does reach manifests, examples, fixtures and templates. The packages registered under `runs` in tests are this change's refusal pins, built from the literal list.
  - `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `235106f`: 0 of its 35 string-valued `namespace:` keys (`crm` 21, `acme` 9, `ex` 3, `probe` 2).
  - `objectstack-ai/gallery` at `ddf3393`: no manifest in the repository.
- **Ask 3 (ADR note).** Under D5, dated 2026-11-11, plus a pointer under the TL;DR 7 note. Additive only.
- **PM assumptions.** All three hold as measured: (1) `inboundHook.literals` was `[]` on `7d82b2da` and the four readers above go through the one judge; (2) core may read the spec constant directly; (3) the boot path keeps and warns a held package for any literal, with no `runs`-specific code (the per-literal boot test).
- **Seat rulings applied after review.** The ADR-0087 disposition is `registered` with one entry for the class (the changeset carries a rename prescription, so `not-required` would contradict it). `Clause-②` reads `no (narrowing)`, as the claim was re-posted (record 6797556648): this diff widens nothing.
- **File surface beyond the claim, accepted by the seat.** Comment lists in `packages/cli` and `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, the docs row, the QA checklist item, the migration entry, and the wire pin in `package-door-namespace-conflict-code.test.ts`.
- **Not in this PR, for the seat.**
  - `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` still lists six literals (follow-up #32429).
  - The pending changesets of #31691 and #31968 list six literals and declare `no-migration-prescription`; the entry added here now covers those six too. They are not edited.
  - The registry's boot warning, the `defineStack` warning and the report's text face still say "its items are read with `?package=`" for every literal. Each follows the judge's scoped sentence, so none is false as composed; tightening them is a class-wide wording change.
  - `check-adr-0087-registration` did not see the rename prescription while the marker read `not-required`, because the changeset spells it FROM and TO in words; carried by #32345 item 2.
  - No test drives this refusal through the install-local door; its `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` is pinned for the class in `@objectstack/cloud-connection`.
- **`origin/main` moved after the merge** (5 commits, `0dc84b02` to `f97a2d9a`). None touches a file of this diff and `git merge-tree` reports a clean merge, so the branch was not merged a second time.
